svg.aria-label: Before: 4 corrections, 4 human checks. You ask for preview environments, then ask again to delete them when the PR closes, to keep them off the prod database, and to cap how many run, with a human check after each round. After: 4 requirements, written once. R1 reachable within 10 minutes, verified by curl /healthz giving 200. R2 deleted within 1 hour of the PR closing, verified by the namespace being gone. R3 cannot reach production databases, verified by a failed connection to the database port. R4 at most 15 run at once, verified by PR 16 getting capacity full.
